title: Trace a classifier
prompt: Implement classify(reason, rules). Rules are (substring, label) pairs. Return the first matching label, else "other". Example: "loading screen for 400 s" matches "loading screen".
tests:
rules = [("loading screen","loading_stuck"),("loading","generic")]
assert classify("loading screen for 400 s",rules) == "loading_stuck", "first matching rule wins"
assert classify("ready",rules) == "other", "unmatched input returns other"
hint: A return ends the function, including its loop.

title: Trace progress state
prompt: Define progress_times(lines, start). Each item is (text, timestamp). Update last only when text starts with "[ladder] result: ". Return last. Example: unrelated text at 99 must not overwrite a result at 20.
tests:
assert progress_times([("[ladder] result: WIN",20),("loading",99)],0) == 20, "only result lines update progress"
assert progress_times([],7) == 7, "no lines preserve the initial value"
hint: Track last on paper after each iteration.

title: Separate selection from saving
prompt: Define unseen(rows, seen), returning rows whose file value is not in seen. Preserve order and do not mutate inputs. Each row has file. Example: seen={"a"} excludes {"file":"a"}.
solution:
def unseen(rows, seen):
    return [row for row in rows if row["file"] not in seen]
tests:
rows = [{"file":"a"},{"file":"b"}]
seen = {"a"}
assert unseen(rows,seen) == [{"file":"b"}], "exclude already seen records"
assert rows == [{"file":"a"},{"file":"b"}] and seen == {"a"}, "do not mutate either input"
assert unseen([],seen) == [], "empty input stays empty"
hint: Selection can return data without performing the later save operation.

title: Inspect source without launching it
prompt: Define source_facts(path) returning entry_guard (whether text contains if __name__ == "__main__":) and definitions (count of lines beginning exactly "def "). Example: indented methods are not top-level definitions. Read the watcher as text only.
tests:
path = "scratchpad/gauntlet/L74/liveops/stuck_watch2.py"
with open(path,encoding="utf-8") as source:
    text = source.read()
expected_count = 0
for line in text.splitlines():
    if line.startswith("def "):
        expected_count += 1
assert source_facts(path) == {"entry_guard": 'if __name__ == "__main__":' in text,"definitions":expected_count}, "inspect current source without executing it"
hint: Use open rather than import for source inspection.
